{{Quote|So I bestow, for the first time in galactic history, our newest and highest honor: the Medal of Imperial Glory.|Darth Decimus|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Medal of Imperial Glory''' was a decorative medal created by [[Darth Decimus]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]]. Following the death of Darth Decimus, the award was discontinued.<ref>{{TORcite|type=codex|Medal of Imperial Glory}}</ref>
